hero.heading: Tumpak Sewu: trek & safety.
hero.lede: The thousand-stream waterfall is reached by a steep, slippery descent through a jungle ravine - visually unmatched and physically demanding.

payload.intro: The viewpoint at the rim takes 10 minutes. The descent into the canyon takes around 90 minutes if taken slowly. Guests should expect wet stone, water spray, and river crossings.

sections.title: The route
items: Panorama viewpoint at the rim - first stop and photo opportunity.
Stairs into the canyon - around 600 irregular steps, slippery in places.
Bamboo ladder section - assisted by local guides.
River crossing - knee-deep in dry season and potentially waist-deep during monsoon.
Base of falls - wide pool, water spray, and dramatic light through the gorge.

sections.title: When not to go
sections.body_md: During and immediately after heavy rain, the canyon floor can flood rapidly. JVTO guides cancel descent when rainfall or water conditions make the canyon unsafe, then substitute an alternative such as Goa Tetes or reschedule where possible.

items.value: Hiking shoes that grip wet rock
